description: Beijing Forestry University publishes industrial heat-source objects for Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei during 2012–2020. The inventory combines 375-metre NPP-VIIRS thermal-anomaly observations with points of interest and higher-resolution imagery. A spatial segmentation procedure identifies objects with coordinates, category codes, administrative locations and inferred first and last operating years. ScienceDB provides the resource free under CC0 1.0. The inspected landing metadata does not identify the storage format. Thermal activity is an indirect indicator, so intermittent operation and low-temperature industrial processes may be missed. Detection years should not be treated as verified commissioning or decommissioning dates. The collection can provide industrial-location proxies for energy-demand allocation and hazard-exposure simulations. No directly related catalogue record was identified for this regional inventory.
name: A dataset of in-operation industrial heat source objects in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region during 2012-2020
